title: chest auto close
description: A small mod that automatically closes the chest if the required item is not found.
body:
### **!!!PEPELAND MODERATION APPROVED!!!**
A small mod that automatically closes the chest if the required item is not found.
  When the item is found, the chest can stay open for a short configurable delay.

  Usage:


```
  /chestautoclose {item} {count}

```

  Closes chest if there are <{count} number of items inside.


```
  /chestautoclose {item}

```

  Closes chest if there are no {item} inside.


```
  /chestautoclose

```

  Disables the mod.


```
  /founddelay {ticks}

```

  Sets delay (in ticks) before closing when the item is found. Default: 2.


```
  /notfounddelay {ticks}

```

  Sets delay (in ticks) before closing when the item is not found. Default: 0.
